exclusion_reason: The Win32 module coverage census exists over the declared module set (kernel32/user32/gdi32 hosted; advapi32/ole32/oleaut32/comctl32/comdlg32/shell32/shlwapi/version/winmm/ws2_32/the CRT family/msvbvm hosted planned): a PE's import table is parsed and each imported module is tiered against the catalog under a ledger that counts hosted, planned, and unrecognized modules, with a fully-hosted flag that is necessary but not sufficient. The benchmark stays red because only the merged kernel32/user32/gdi32 lanes carry a passing conformance slice — a title on the broader module set cannot start until every imported module carries its slice, under the BPTK-002 corpus denominator.
promotion_trigger: Promote when every declared module passes its conformance slice with the ledger holding the gap budget.
expected_failing_assertion: A title importing a planned module is flagged not-fully-hosted and the census stays blocked with no title started.
active_gate_evidence: test/import.test.mjs asserts the hosted/planned/unrecognized tiering and ledger totals, the not-fully-hosted flag for a broader-module title, dedup/lowercase/order-independence, a real PE import-table census that stays blocked, and real-CLI reachability.
procedure: Run each declared module conformance slice.
Assert COM marshaling and side-by-side activation cases pass.
Assert the ledger holds the gap budget for the module set.
pass_criterion: Gap stay within the declared budget.
